title: Working bubbles name their model
text: While an agent works on a card, its bubble now shows which harness and model that session runs on, such as Claude Code with Opus or Codex with GPT-5.5. The same goes for Obeya's own reading bubble and for answers being looked up. The label always comes from the session that is actually running, so cards started before a settings change keep showing the model they really use.
